svg.title: One aggregate hides the slow-group error
svg.desc: All 480 cells per energy group, retained OpenMC reference and fresh frozen-model prediction, plus signed error. Combined relative L2 is 5.56 percent, slow 21.66 percent, fast 3.86 percent. Shared field and error scales; two zero predictions gray. No new transport run or physical accuracy claim.
